title: PCB-Spec Manifest
description: Constraint manifest for a PCB project. The single source of truth for stackup, rules, net classes, placement intent, and conformance gates.

manifest_version.description: Schema version. Only '0.1' is supported in this release.

project.description: Project identity: name and revision string.

stackup.description: Physical layer stackup. Dielectric parameters are referenced by fab stackup ID, not inlined.

fab_house_id.description: Opaque fab house identifier, e.g. 'jlcpcb'. The validator does not check this against a known-fab library; that belongs to a separate spec.

stackup_id.description: Fab-specific stackup ID that encodes dielectric, prepreg, and core thicknesses. References the fab's capability sheet.

layers.description: Ordered list of copper layers. No duplicate layer numbers allowed.

type.description: Layer function: signal carries routed traces; plane is a solid copper pour; mixed combines both.

copper_oz.description: Copper weight in oz/ft². Common values: 0.5, 1, 2.

rules.description: Rule tables for current capacity, spacing, fab DFM, and impedance. Each subsection requires a citation. Numeric values are populated by the standards-rule-library spec.

current_capacity.description: Current-carrying capacity rules. Values sourced from IPC-2152.

spacing.description: Clearance and creepage spacing rules. Values sourced from IPC-2221.

fab_dfm.description: Fab-specific DFM minimums: trace width, annular ring, drill size, etc.

impedance.description: Impedance constraint rules and named profiles for controlled-impedance nets.

citation.description: Source standard or reference for impedance rules, e.g. 'IPC-2141A'.

profiles.description: Named impedance profiles referenced by net classes.

net_classes.description: Named groups of nets sharing routing constraints. Keys use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.

placement.description: Component placement intents. Optional. Each entry records where or how a component should be placed relative to nets or other components.

gates.description: Conformance gates grouped by phase. Each gate has a stable ID used in violation reports.

schematic.description: Schematic-phase gates: logical correctness, pin assignment, decoupling.

layout.description: Layout-phase gates: trace geometry, impedance, return paths.

dfm.description: DFM-phase gates: fab capability minimums, courtyard clearances.

rule_section.description: A rule subsection with a mandatory citation and a list of structured entries.

citation.description: Source standard or document for these rules, e.g. 'IPC-2152, Table 5-1'.

entries.description: Structured rule entries. Shape defined by the standards-rule-library spec.

impedance_profile.description: A named impedance target for controlled-impedance routing.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by net class rules.

tolerance_pct.description: Allowed deviation from target, as a percentage (e.g. 10 means ±10%).

net_class.description: A group of nets sharing routing rules and constraints.

description.description: Human-readable description of what nets belong to this class.

members.description: List of net names belonging to this class.

rules.description: Routing rules applied to all nets in this class.

route_layers.description: Layer names on which nets in this class are permitted to route.

impedance_profile.description: ID of an impedance profile in rules.impedance.profiles. Cross-reference validated by the Pydantic loader.

placement_constraint.description: Placement intent for a single component.

component_id.description: Component reference designator, e.g. 'U1'. Must resolve to a component in the BOM library (checked by the conformance-checker spec).

net_class.description: Net class this component is associated with. Must resolve to a defined net class. Cross-reference validated by the Pydantic loader.

notes.description: Free-form placement notes for the layout engineer.

gate.description: A single conformance gate with a stable ID and a free-form rule string.

id.description: Stable gate ID used in violation reports, e.g. 'SCH-001'. Never reuse or reorder IDs.

rule.description: Human-readable rule statement. The conformance-checker spec implements the check logic.
